Title: Job Application for Data Engineer at Alt

URL Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_app?for=alt&jr_id=6966a94aa112b40266149cd7&token=7588614003

Markdown Content:
[Alt](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/alt.xyz) is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real-time pricing at scale-the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform.

### The Role

Are you a data engineer who thrives on building robust pipelines and solving complex data challenges? In this role, you'll own Alt's critical data infrastructure that powers our pricing model and marketplace insights by ingesting transaction and listing data from dozens of external marketplaces. You'll be responsible for ensuring our data pipelines deliver fresh, accurate information that drives pricing decisions, market analytics, and business intelligence across the entire platform.

### What you'll do here

* Design, optimize and own data pipelines that scrape, process and ingest transaction and listing data from major auction houses and marketplaces.
* Build comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to track latency, uptime, and coverage metrics across all data sources.
* Continuously improve our data infrastructure by modernizing storage and processing technologies, reducing manual interventions, and optimizing for cost, performance, and reliability.
* Partner with internal teams to understand data usage patterns and ensure pipelines deliver clean, standardized data that meets product requirements.

### This is a perfect fit if you...

* Care deeply about data quality and understand that extraction is only the beginning - the real value comes from delivering clean and usable data.
* Thrive in a startup environment where you can make immediate impact and own critical systems end-to-end.
* Take an incremental approach to improvements, preferring evidence-based decisions over wholesale replacements.
* Are intellectually curious about how data flows through systems and passionate about automation opportunities.
* Want to work at the intersection of data engineering and product, understanding how your pipelines directly impact business outcomes.

### What you bring to the table

Must-haves:

* 3-4 years of experience in data engineering or related fields
* Strong Python proficiency with at least 3 years of hands-on experience
* Proven experience with large-scale data processing using dataframe technologies (Pandas, Polars, PySpark, or similar)
* Hands-on experience with pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or similar DAG-based systems)
* Track record of owning at least one data pipeline end-to-end within the past 2 years
* Solid SQL skills for data analysis and transformation
* Previous startup experience - you understand the pace and adaptability required in a fast-moving environment
* A pragmatic mindset focused on delivering value incrementally rather than pursuing perfection

Nice-to-haves:

* Experience with web scraping technologies (Selenium, Puppeteer, Beautiful Soup)
* Familiarity with data infrastructure and cloud services (AWS preferred)
* Interest in or knowledge of trading cards, collectibles, or alternative asset markets
* Experience with LLM-based automation tools for data extraction and processing

### **What You'll Get From Us**

* A seat at the table to help shape the future of Alt and the alternative asset space
* Autonomy and ownership on projects that matter
* $100/month work-from-home stipend
* $200/month wellness stipend
* WeWork office stipend
* 401(k) retirement benefits
* Flexible vacation policy
* Generous paid parental leave
* Competitive healthcare benefits, including HSA, for you and your dependent(s)

**Base salary range:**$155,000-$165,000, plus equity. Offers may vary based on experience, location, and other factors.

Description
Junior AI Data Engineer
Position Summary
We are seeking a Junior AI Data Engineer to support the development of modern data pipelines, data models, and AI-ready analytics assets. This role will help build and maintain data ingestion workflows using Dagster, transform and model data using dbt, and support the creation of curated MART tables used by internal AI agents for analytics and insight generation.
The Junior AI Data Engineer will also assist with the development of data schemas, internal tools, and supporting code using Claude Code as part of the development workflow. This role is ideal for someone early in their data engineering career who is interested in modern data platforms, AI-assisted software development, and the use of structured data to power AI agents.
Data produced by these pipelines will be consumed by AI agents in two primary ways: some data will be delivered directly as payloads to the agents, while other data will be retrieved from MART tables through an internal MCP server. AI agents are hosted on AWS Bedrock.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in building, testing, and maintaining data ingestion pipelines using Dagster.
Support the orchestration of scheduled, event-driven, and dependency-aware data workflows.
Develop and maintain dbt models for staging, transformation, and MART-layer data structures.
Help design and maintain schemas for source data, transformed datasets, MART tables, and AI-agent-facing data structures.
Write and maintain SQL transformations, tests, documentation, and data quality checks in dbt.
Support the creation of clean, reliable MART tables that enable analytics, reporting, and AI-driven insights.
Assist in developing internal tools, utilities, and supporting code using Claude Code as part of the software development process.
Use Claude Code to accelerate development of data pipeline logic, schema definitions, dbt models, documentation, tests, and internal tooling under the guidance of team members.
Collaborate with senior product and development teams to define data contracts, pipeline dependencies, schema standards, and transformation patterns.
Support data delivery patterns for AI agents, including direct payload generation and MART-based retrieval.
Work with internal teams to ensure data exposed through the MCP server is accurate, well-structured, secure, and fit for AI-agent consumption.
Assist with troubleshooting pipeline failures, schema mismatches, data quality issues, and transformation errors.
Learn and apply best practices for data engineering, observability, testing, deployment, and responsible use of AI development tools.
Collaborate with AI Development teams working with AWS Bedrock-based agents.
Required Qualifications
Foundational experience with SQL and relational data concepts.
Basic experience with Python or another scripting language.
Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT concepts, APIs, JSON, or structured data formats.
Interest in data modeling, schema design, analytics engineering, and modern data platforms.
Ability to troubleshoot issues logically and communicate findings clearly.
Willingness to learn tools such as Dagster, dbt, Claude Code, AWS services, MCP, and AI-agent data patterns.
Comfortable working in a collaborative technical environment using Git via Azure DevOps.
Ability to follow development standards, review generated code critically, and ask questions when implementation details are unclear.
Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or another orchestration framework.
Exposure to dbt or analytics engineering workflows.
Experience creating or maintaining reporting tables, data marts, dimensional models, or semantic data layers.
Familiarity with schema design, data contracts, validation rules, or metadata documentation.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Basic understanding of APIs, JSON payloads, MCP-style tool access patterns, and data exchange between systems.
Interest in AI, large language models, AWS Bedrock, or agent-based analytics systems.
Basic familiarity with data quality testing, documentation, CI/CD practices, and code review workflows.
Technical Environment
Dagster for data orchestration and pipeline management.
dbt for data transformation, modeling, testing, and documentation.
SQL-based MART tables for curated analytics-ready datasets.
Schema definitions and data contracts for reliable downstream consumption
Internal MCP server for AI-agent access to structured MART data.
AWS Bedrock for AI agent execution.
Claude Code for AI-assisted development of schemas, tools, code, tests, and documentation.
Git-based development and collaborative code review workflows.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is early in their data engineering career and eager to grow into a strong contributor on a modern data platform team. They should be curious, detail-oriented, comfortable learning new tools, and interested in building reliable data foundations that support both traditional analytics and AI-powered insight generation.
This person should be comfortable using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, including reviewing, testing, and refining generated code rather than accepting it blindly. They should enjoy working with SQL, structured data, schemas, pipelines, and internal tools while learning how data engineering and AI agent systems work together in a production environment.

Position Overview Section 

We are seeking a highly qualified Data Engineer / Python & SQL Developer to support the design, development, and deployment of data engineering and ETL solutions in a mission-focused environment. Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution documentation, interface specifications, data flow diagrams, and operational procedures.

 
Participate in Agile delivery processes, including backlog management, sprint planning, status tracking, and issue resolution using Jira.

Contribute to continuous improvement of data engineering practices, processes, and solutions.

Advanced or expert-level experience developing solutions using Python and SQL.

Strong understanding of database design, data modeling, and data architecture best practices.

 
Experience with table design, stored procedure development, query optimization, and data integrity.

 
Demonstrated ability to develop scalable, maintainable, and secure data pipelines.

 
Experience producing clear, structured technical documentation for both development and operational purposes.

 
Experience working within Agile development teams and using Jira for workflow and delivery management.

 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.

Experience at the Consultant/Senior Consultant level, or equivalent USDC/PDM/Specialist level.

Prior experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) or U.S. Air Force programs.

 
Existing Air Force credentials and/or the ability to work within a secure or controlled government environment.

 
Familiarity with secure data handling, compliance-driven delivery, and mission-focused technology programs.

 
Experience working within complex enterprise data environments with multiple upstream and downstream integrations.

 
Experience supporting large-scale cloud data environments and enterprise ETL architectures.

Job description
The Sr. AI Engineer will report directly to the Sr. Director of Data Analytics & AI Ecosystems and serve as a primary hands-on builder within the company's AI Ecosystem, anchored by the AIMES (AI Mini-Ecosystem) platform. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining Copilot Studio agents, Power Automate orchestration flows, Python-based tooling and dashboards, and supporting the training, tuning, and evaluation of AI models used across the organization. 
This role combines hands-on AI/automation engineering with data analytics capability. In the near term, the emphasis is on building out the AI Ecosystem: agents, automation, and integrations. As that build-out matures, the role is expected to shift toward analyzing the data and outcomes produced by those systems, generating insights, and supporting data-driven decision-making alongside the Sr. Director. The Sr. AI Engineer should be equally comfortable building an agent and analyzing the data it produces, with strong Python fundamentals, disciplined GitHub/CI-CD practices, and the ability to translate ecosystem roadmap priorities into working, production-ready solutions on the existing Microsoft 365 E5 platform. 
 
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain Copilot Studio agents, including conversational flows, tool/function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) integration against the SharePoint Document Repository. 
Develop, test, and support Power Automate flows for orchestration, approval routing, reminders/escalation, and reconciliation, following documented build and change-control discipline. 
Write and maintain Python code for automation scripting, API integrations, data pipelines, and dashboard generation (e.g., Chart.js-based visualizations). 
Support AI model training, fine-tuning, and prompt engineering efforts, including embeddings generation, vector search configuration, and RAG pipeline construction and upkeep. 
Manage source control in GitHub, following branching, pull-request review, and versioning discipline consistent with team standards. 
Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for AI and automation deliverables, ensuring reliable, repeatable, and auditable deployment. 
Integrate solutions with the broader Microsoft 365 / Power Platform environment, including SharePoint, Dataverse, and related services. 
Maintain documentation, testing evidence, and change logs aligned with the organization's SOX and CMMC compliance requirements, including human sign-off on automated approvals and per-action audit logging. 
Partner with the Sr. Director of Data Analytics & AI Ecosystems to execute the AIMES roadmap and support enterprise AI Ecosystem initiatives (Automation Hub, Intelligence Hub, and related components). 
Troubleshoot production automation and agent issues, verifying ground truth against live system behavior rather than assumed outcomes. 
Contribute to cross-training efforts, sharing AI/automation engineering knowledge with other members of the Data Analytics & AI Ecosystems team. 
Analyze data generated by AI agents, automation flows, and integrated systems to identify trends, performance issues, and opportunities for improvement. 
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that translate AI Ecosystem activity and outcomes into actionable insight for the Sr. Director and business stakeholders. 
Partner with the Sr. Director on data analytics work as the AI Ecosystem build-out matures, with the expectation that analytics responsibility grows over time as agent and automation development stabilizes.

Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity,cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)-a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software-WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.

With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture-grounded in core values and leadership philosophies-has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams?Join WWT today!

**What is the Internal WWT IT Team, and why join?**

The Internal WWT IT team is the backbone of our company's technological infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations and continuous innovation. Our team is dedicated to managing and supporting the company's technological infrastructure, ensuring the smooth operation of hardware, software, networks, and data systems, while providing top-notch technical support to employees.

By joining the Internal WWT IT team, you will play a crucial role in maintaining the efficiency and security of our IT environment, enabling the company to achieve its strategic goals. The Internal IT team offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your contributions will directly impact the company's success. If you are passionate about technology and eager to take on new challenges, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

**What will you be doing?**

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team of solution architects and data scientists on a wide range of business problems. You will be an integral part of the IT HCM Analytics team, who is responsible for building out capabilities across business strategy, analytics, and Cloud.

The role's primary focus will be on architecting and maintaining our data pipeline and ETL processes, building integrations, and developing complex data models to foster data-driven decision making across all functional areas.

Data Engineer must be able to:

* Independently execute on all phases of the Data Engineer project lifecycle

* Gain subject matter expertise in various business domain

* Apply technical expertise to solve complex business problems

* Effectively communicate with business stakeholders for successful project execution

* Mentor team member

**Responsibilities:**

* Support our Analytics partners embedded in the business, providing data to analysts across the company.

* Be an equal member of a cohesive and selfless team.

* Take complete ownership of your work with the goal of exceeding customer expectations.

* Work closely with analysts, developers, and data architects to ensure development meets requirements and delivers optimal performance.

* Consult on the design, development, and implementation of innovative solutions to complicated data issues which enhance traditional star-schema data structures.

* Expertise in Data Engineering and implement multiple end-to-end DW projects in Big Data environment.

* Support and debug issues in production environment and be part of production support, across several reporting toolsets.

* Work in an agile team - plan, prioritize design, test, and coordinate end-to-end delivery of solutions.

* Embrace the opportunity to expand your skillset both functionally and technically.

* Design, create, and implement complex data models (including canonical, conceptual, logical, and physical models).

* Implement new design methodologies.

* Build, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure and data products.

* Implement physical database models and tune SQL.

* Use ANSI SQL and/or PL/SQL to perform data analysis.

* Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and "big data" technologies.

* Flexibility to work as a member of a matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project teams.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree - Computer Science or a minimum of 5 years' progressive experience in a related field.

* 3+ years of experience in analytics, SQL, and/or ETL development.

* Proficiency in data warehousing/business intelligence development/data modeling.

* 3+ years' experience building large scale data sources in Oracle or equivalent relational database.

* 3+ years' experience using API platforms such as MuleSoft /APIGee and ELT platform such as Matilli o n or Informatica.

* Have excellent SQL skills with PL/SQL development experience.

* Hands-on development experience using an ETL tool;Oracle Data Integrator preferred.

* Hands-on development experience with Oracle Cloud reporting and data replication; Business Intelligence Cloud Connector Console, BI Publisher, and OTBI preferred.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

* Experience with BI reporting tools like Tableau,Power BI.

* Programming skills: Java, Scala, Python.

* Expertise with CI/CD pipeline and integration tools e.g., Jenkins, GIT.

* Understand an analytics platform, its use-cases, and best practices.

* Experience working with different types of data stores (RDMS, Flat Files, Columnar DBs, etc.)

* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data lakes, and data vault.

* Experience with Clo u d-based environment, Saas.

* Experience with any of the cloud warehousing products e.g.Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.

* Experience with MS Power Platform.

* Experience working with cloud environments Azure.

* Experience in designing Data Architecture and pipelines.

* Proficient in performance tuning and debugging.

* Experience required to work in a fast-paced environment with a focus on delivering customer satisfaction.

* Travel - up to 10% of the time._(domestic and international)_

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day:
PR-driven shipping:
 Opening and merging pull requests for new or updated Dagster jobs, assets, schedules, and sensors, plus dbt models, tests, and documentation.
Infrastructure tweaks:
 Writing occasional Terraform for secrets, environment variables, or job sizing when a pipeline needs it.
Pipeline implementation:
 Building and debugging Python pipelines covering REST/API syncs, large Postgres extracts, Parquet loads, and Snowflake COPY operations.
Airbyte management:
 Configuring or troubleshooting Airbyte connections wherever managed sync is the right fit.
Production monitoring:
 Watching production runs and investigating failures related to IAM, OOM, Spot instances, or bad watermarks.
Backfills & catch-ups:
 Running backfills and incremental catch-ups with a clear story for what landed and why.
Modeling partnership:
 Working with analytics and product on dim/fct/x_fct design, incremental strategies, and data quality.
Code review & runbooks:
 Participating in code review, release prep, and writing short runbooks so others can operate your pipelines when you're out.

Warehouse fundamentals:
 Solid grasp of relational databases and warehouse patterns - keys, grain, normalization vs. star schema, and how SCD behavior gets encoded.
Orchestration experience:
 Practical, hands-on Dagster (or Airflow) experience - not just writing SQL inside a scheduler UI.
dbt proficiency:
 Real experience building and maintaining models, tests, and documentation in dbt.
Python at scale:
 Comfort reading and writing Python that moves data at scale across extract, transform, and load steps.
AWS working knowledge:
 Practical familiarity with S3, IAM, and ECS/Fargate at a "debug my job" level.
EL tool familiarity:
 Experience with Airbyte or similar extract-and-load tools.
PR discipline:
 The discipline to write pull requests others can easily review, and to give equally rigorous reviews in return.
Reliability mindset:
 A track record of keeping pipelines healthy and modeling consistent across full refresh and incremental paths, without becoming a single point of failure.

At Underdog, we make sports more fun.
Our thesis is simple: build the best product for sports fans and we will win the space. Founded in 2020, we're one of the fastest-growing sports companies ever, and there's still so much left to do. We've built and scaled products across fantasy sports, sports betting, and prediction markets, all united in one app that's seamless, intuitive, and actually fun to use.
Underdog isn't for everyone. One of our core values is give a sh*t. The people who win here are the ones who care, push, and perform. We're remote-first by design, but highly collaborative with regular in-person gatherings that help teams build, iterate, and move fast together.
Got that dog in you? Join us.
After all, winning as an Underdog is more fun.
What you'll do:
As a Senior Analytics Engineer on our Regulatory Reporting team, you'll own the data platform that powers Underdog's prediction markets business. This is a high-impact, zero-to-one opportunity. We're scaling fast and building the regulatory reporting infrastructure from the ground up. You'll work directly with regulatory bodies, partner across engineering, product, compliance, and senior leadership, and have broad exposure to how a federally regulated prediction markets exchange operates at every level.
It starts with hands-on work in a process that's still being built. That's how you'll learn the system and understand exactly what needs to be automated. The goal is to build your way there: purpose-built dbt models, automated validations, resilient pipelines, and eventually a platform that runs with minimal manual intervention. If you're the kind of engineer who wants to build something from scratch that genuinely matters, this is it.
Own requirements for our regulatory reporting data platform, working directly with regulatory bodies to define and refine what's needed as prediction markets continue to evolve.
Design and architect purpose-built dbt models and pipelines connected directly to raw data, powering our full suite of regulatory reports independent of upstream analytics models.
Define the automated validation layer: test cases, cross-validation of reporting outputs, and alerting so that when something breaks, the team knows exactly what and why.
Lead audit and exam support, own the data side of exam responses, and represent the team with regulators and internal compliance.
Drive break investigations to root cause, own the engineering relationship, and set the standard for how permanent fixes get scoped and shipped.
Design and lead the on-call rotation framework for the broader team.
Define how upstream data changes from product and engineering get monitored and governed through the reporting layer.
Own the roadmap for surveillance reporting, market maker monitoring, and pre-launch submission validation as the function grows.
Who you are:
Builder first: You want to build a platform, not maintain a spreadsheet. You think in systems, pipelines, and automation, and you know what it takes to build something that runs reliably.
Investigator: When something breaks, you dig. You're comfortable in raw data, you chase root causes, and you don't stop until you know exactly what happened and why.
Regulator-facing: You can hold a conversation with a regulatory body, translate ambiguous requirements into data definitions, and represent the team externally. This is not a back-office role.
Reliable under deadline: You understand what it means to own a process with a hard cutoff. You're accountable, you communicate early when something looks off, and you don't leave things for someone else to catch.
Strong SQL and dbt: You can write complex queries, build modular dbt models with proper testing, and you care about the quality of what you ship.
Excited by the scope: You want a role where your work touches engineering, product, compliance, and leadership. You thrive when you can see how everything connects.

Experience in a federally regulated environment at a prediction markets platform, fintech, crypto exchange, or neobank.
Background in regulatory reporting, reconciliation, or trade-level data at a tech-forward financial company.
Experience in the sports industry, particularly fantasy sports or sports betting.
Experience building automated reporting pipelines or validation frameworks from scratch.
Experience with data contracts, schema registries, or similar approaches to managing upstream data dependencies.

Familiarity with orchestration tooling (Airflow or similar) and pipeline monitoring.
Python for data investigation, tooling, or lightweight automation.
Any exposure to prediction markets, derivatives, or exchange operations.

About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. 

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.
 

 
About the Role 
 

Armada is hiring a Data Center Constructability Engineer to support the Galleon and Leviathan product lines - a brand-new capability for the company. As we scale Modular Data Center (MDC) deployments across a growing number of sites and geographies, we need someone who can own the constructability thread that runs from early site due diligence and design review through pre-construction planning, fabrication, installation, and commissioning, and make sure what gets designed can actually be built, on schedule, everywhere we operate.

You will review Leviathan/Galleon MDC and site designs for buildability, validate deployment methodologies (crane and access, sequencing, tolerances, and fit-up) before they're locked in, and build the standardized, repeatable construction playbooks that turn site execution into a repeatable process instead of a one-off plan per site. You'll also be the constructability point of contact linking Armada's product and engineering teams with fabricators, general contractors, and local delivery partners, supporting pre-construction planning and reviewing design packages and shop drawings to make sure what's designed matches how it will actually be built in the field.

 

Location

This role is Remote in the U.S. (approximately 30-40% travel to project sites, fabrication facilities, and vendor/GC locations).

 

 

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)
 

Constructability review & product feedback loop - 
Review Leviathan/Galleon MDC and site designs (civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, piping, controls, ICT, IT) at each stage gate and feed constructability input directly into product development - modularity, transport and lifting constraints, ISO container/skid interfaces, installation sequencing, and commissioning strategy - catching buildability issues while they are still cheap to fix, before they are locked into issued-for-construction drawings.

 

Deployment methodology validation & site-specific risk assessment - 
Validate deployment methodologies for Leviathan across candidate and active sites worldwide (crane selection and access, laydown and site logistics, erection/installation sequencing, tolerances and fit-up), and own early constructability due diligence that flags site-specific vendor, access, or execution risk before it causes late-stage redesign or slips a deployment.

 

Standardized, repeatable construction playbooks - 
Develop and maintain repeatable construction playbooks, sequencing plans, and methods of procedure for single-unit and campus-scale Leviathan deployments, turning site execution into a repeatable, SKU-like process instead of a one-off plan per site and region.

 

Hands-on constructability analysis for new products & first-of-a-kind sites - 
Personally lead constructability analysis (crane/lift studies, transport and logistics modeling, installation sequencing) for new Armada products or site conditions where no vendor, GC, or prior-site precedent exists yet, establishing the buildability basis in-house before handing execution off to local contractors and fabricators.

 

Pre-construction planning & cross-discipline coordination through execution - 
Act as the constructability point of contact linking Armada product engineering with civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, piping, controls, ICT, and IT disciplines, fabricators, and general contractors; support pre-construction planning (schedule, cost, logistics, procurement lead times) and review design packages and shop drawings for buildability, ensuring what is designed can actually be fabricated, transported, and installed as sequenced and on schedule.

 

Constructability governance, documentation & readiness sign-off - 
Build and maintain constructability guidelines, buildability/site-readiness checklists, and review workflows by geography; track open constructability items and lessons learned across active sites; and provide the final constructability sign-off confirming a site's design and execution plan are buildable and ready to proceed to construction.

Verifi, part of Saint-Gobain, is an expanding global SaaS and IoT technology company focused on the construction industry. Dedicated to connecting the physical world with intelligent software. We are revolutionizing the industrial construction space. We provide end-to-end solutions-from embedded sensors to cloud-based analytics-that help companies boost efficiency, ensure sustainability, and unlock actionable insights. We are building a supportive, high-performance team to drive the next wave of digital transformation. Join us to build, scale, and innovate at the edge.
The Senior Data Engineer will be responsible for owning the AI and data pipeline for the engineering organization. The ideal candidate will act as the subject matter expert around Verifi's data. The role will support both development and data science teams to work with our data.
Reporting to the CTO, the Senior Data Engineer is a key part of the engineering organization working across teams to set the standards around secure and scalable data access, including real time streams.
This is a highly visible role to help drive the architecture for Verifi's data backend.
IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?
This is a unique role in Engineering driving industry proven AI and data pipelines while working with existing technologies (e.g., Azure Data Explorer, SQL Server)
• Pipeline Architecture: Architect real-time, transactional, and reporting data pipelines 
• Infrastructure Management: Responsible for the data backend design using existing technologies (e.g, Azure Data Explorer, SQL Server) 
• Automation Focused: Designed a universal semantic layer to automate recurring reports, eliminating manual Tableau workbook intervention, making data available via REST and GraphQL APIs 
• Model Integration and Deployment: Developed and deployed predictive machine learning models directly into the data pipeline, specifically for real-time predictions 
• Efficiency and Optimization: Ability to analyze data backend performance and eliminate bottlenecks 
• Collaboration: Works across disciplines between development, data science, and product teams 
• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, organized and detail oriented

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related field

7+ years of data engineering experience with machine learning and model development 
7+ years of designing data pipeline for both real-time, transactional, and reporting scenarios 
Proficient in Kusto Query Language (KQL) around best practices for performance at scale 
Proven ability to lead through influence rather than direct authority 
Cross collaboration between disciplines, including development, data science, and product 
PREFERRED WORK EXPERIENCE:

Knowledge of Python for data analysis and mining

What you will be doing: 
Own the end to end architecture: ingestion, lakehouse and warehouse layers, transformation, modeling, and delivery to reporting and analytics tools.
Build it. Write and deploy pipelines, Spark and SQL transformations, and data models, and review the code the rest of the team writes.
Design lakehouse architectures on Databricks or Fabric, including medallion layering, Delta table design, and the semantic layer that sits on top.
Make the platform call and defend it. Databricks, Fabric, or a mix, based on the client's workloads, existing licensing, skills, and cost profile.
Set up governance and access control using Unity Catalog, Purview, or the equivalent, and apply it consistently rather than bolting it on at the end.
Design and build ingestion from a wide range of sources: databases, SaaS applications, APIs, files, and legacy systems that were never meant to be integrated.

Eight or more years in data engineering, with at least three years owning architecture and design decisions.
Proven hands on delivery. You should be able to point at platforms you designed and also built.
Deep hands on experience with Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and working knowledge of the other. Comfortable explaining where each one fits and where it does not.
Strong Spark and SQL. Solid Python or an equivalent language used in production data work.
Experience with Delta Lake, medallion architecture, and lakehouse patterns in production, not just in a demo.
Power BI, including how the semantic model is built and where it should live.
Solid dimensional and semantic modeling skills. You should have opinions about where business logic belongs and be able to explain why.
Working knowledge of data governance: classification, lineage, cataloging, and access control.
CI/CD, version control, and testing practices applied to data work, not just to application code.

Azure Government or GCC High delivery experience.

## Job Summary:

Our Revenue Compliance platforms generate a large and growing volume of tax, licensing, and compliance data. Today, much of the work of moving, reconciling, and reporting on that data depends on legacy tooling and manual steps.

The Data Engineer designs and builds the pipelines and data models that our reporting, analytics, and emerging AI initiatives depend on, and retires the manual and legacy processes those functions rely on today. The role also supports the data side of our migration to Amazon Aurora, ensuring that downstream reporting and extracts move cleanly as source systems change. This is a foundational position with wide scope and real constraints, suited to an engineer who wants to define how a data platform gets built rather than maintain an existing design.

## Duties and Responsibilities:

* Design, implement, and operate ETL and ELT pipelines that move data from transactional systems into analytical and reporting environments on schedule, with monitoring and alerting sufficient to establish confidence in the results.
* Replace legacy and manual data processes with maintainable, version-controlled, tested pipelines, reducing the number of steps that depend on an individual remembering a procedure.
* Design warehouse schemas and data models that make reporting consistent across products rather than requiring each report to define its own logic.
* Support the Amazon Aurora migration by ensuring downstream pipelines, extracts, and reporting move cleanly as source systems migrate, and by validating data integrity through cutover.
* Build validation, reconciliation, and alerting into pipelines so that data quality issues are identified before a customer or auditor encounters them.
* Partner with architecture and AI initiatives to prepare clean, well-structured, and well-documented datasets that enable downstream analytical and machine learning work.
* Work with application engineers, the database administrator, site reliability, and business stakeholders to establish what the data means, not solely where it resides.
* Maintain clear documentation of data sources, lineage, and business definitions.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into concrete data requirements, and exercise independent judgment in selecting the appropriate technical approach.
* At the senior level, mentor other contributors and raise the overall data engineering practice of the team.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

## Education and Experience:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Four to eight years of data engineering experience, including production ownership of pipelines the candidate personally designed and built.
* Demonstrated experience designing and operating ETL and ELT pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, error handling, and retry logic.
* Hands-on experience with a cloud data platform. AWS preferred; Azure or GCP considered.
* Data warehouse and dimensional modeling experience sufficient to defend schema design decisions.
* Experience applying version control and CI/CD practices to data work, not solely to application code.
* Experience with AWS-native data tooling such as Glue, DMS, S3, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, or Step Functions.
* Experience with pipeline orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, and with transformation tooling such as dbt.
* Experience migrating reporting and analytics workloads alongside a database platform migration.
* Experience replacing legacy or low-code data tooling such as Alteryx or SSIS with engineered pipelines.
* Experience preparing data foundations for machine learning or AI use cases.
* Background in tax, financial services, government technology, or another regulated, audit-sensitive domain.
* Experience with data governance, lineage, and cataloging practices.

## Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

* Advanced SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization, together with the judgment to recognize when a query is the wrong tool.
* Strong Python for data engineering, using pandas, SQLAlchemy, or equivalent libraries, and general scripting proficiency.
* Working knowledge of relational database platforms such as MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.
* Knowledge of dimensional modeling and data warehouse design principles.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into concrete, testable data requirements.
* Ability to design and defend technical approaches independently, and to make architectural decisions with limited supervision.
* Clear written communication, including the ability to produce documentation that others can rely on without follow-up.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, reliability, and business stakeholders in a fully remote environment.
* Knowledge of data quality, reconciliation, and observability practices for production pipelines.
* Ability to mentor other engineers and establish shared standards across a team.

**Work Environment**:

* Office setting with a moderate noise level.
* The employee will work at an individual workstation, using a telephone and computer.

**Physical Demands**:

* Must be able to remain seated for extended periods.
* Regular use of a computer and other office machinery, such as printers and copy machines.
* Occasional movement around the office.
* Frequent communication via telephone.

Dave vs. Goliath. We're Dave.
Dave is a financial app on a mission to build products that level the financial playing field. It is redefining the financial landscape by leveraging technology to create an affordable, transparent, and user-centric access to liquidity for millions of Americans. As a leading innovator in the U.S. financial services sector, Dave's digital financial platform offers products designed to meet the credit needs of those underserved by traditional financial institutions. Dave's offerings include its flagship ExtraCash product, providing members up to $500 within minutes. The company is on track to launch several new product offerings in 2026, including a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) option.
Dave is focused on serving Americans who are financially vulnerable or living paycheck to paycheck. Dave is leading the charge in creating a new era of credit products that prioritizes speed, affordability, and accessibility, making it the go-to financial partner for those who need it most.
Data Engineer II
We're hiring a Data Engineer II to help build and improve the data systems that power decision-making across Dave. You'll develop reliable pipelines and platform capabilities while growing your ownership of production data systems and the business outcomes they support.
The Opportunity
Data is central to how Dave builds products, manages risk, understands our members, and makes decisions. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced Data Engineers and partners across Analytics, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Marketing, Product, and Engineering. You'll own well-defined data engineering projects from implementation through production support and help make our platform more reliable, scalable, and efficient. You'll also have opportunities to apply AI-assisted development tools and support emerging AI initiatives as we evolve how we build and use data at Dave.
What You'll Build and Own
Build, maintain, and improve reliable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data across Dave's data platform.
Own data engineering projects and pipelines through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing support.
Work with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow/Cloud Composer, APIs, files, and cloud services to support production workloads and optimize them for reliability, performance, scalability, and cost.
Support warehouse development through thoughtful schema design, data modeling, testing, documentation, data quality practices, and query optimization.
Improve ingestion, orchestration, validation, retries, backfills, monitoring, and alerting while helping reduce recurring operational work.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to accelerate development, debugging, documentation, and analysis while maintaining strong standards for accuracy, security, review, and engineering judgment.
The Impact
The systems you build help teams across Dave make dependable, data-driven decisions and ultimately build better financial products for our members. As your experience grows, you'll take on broader technical and domain ownership and help shape how our data platform evolves.
What We're Looking For
2+ years of software or data engineering experience, including experience building or supporting production data systems.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or another general-purpose language, plus strong SQL skills.
Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and working with technologies such as dbt, Fivetran, or similar tools.
Experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Cloud Composer.
Understanding of data modeling, data quality, relational data, and query and performance optimization.
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, code reviews, and CI/CD.
Ability to troubleshoot production systems methodically and communicate effectively with technical and business partners.
Bonus Points
Experience with financial or other highly regulated datasets.
Familiarity with GCP technologies such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage.
Exposure to streaming or event-driven data pipelines, data observability, or incident-management tooling.
Familiarity with GraphDB/Neo4j, data governance, privacy, access controls, or PII handling.
Experience supporting AI or machine learning data workflows, including pipelines, integrations, or data preparation for AI-powered applications.
What Makes Someone Successful Here
You take responsibility for outcomes, not just completed tickets. You ask thoughtful questions, understand how your pipelines affect downstream teams and members, and make practical trade-offs between speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability. You care about building systems that hold up over time and look for opportunities to improve how the work gets done.
You also work well across boundaries. You seek feedback, share context, and collaborate with partners to arrive at stronger solutions. Not everything will be fully defined, and you're comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and adjusting your approach as new information emerges.
What to Expect
You'll have meaningful ownership with support from experienced engineers. Priorities evolve as our products and data needs change, giving you opportunities to learn, contribute to design discussions, and progressively take on broader technical responsibility.
Why Dave
Dave (NASDAQ: DAVE) is a profitable, publicly traded fintech serving millions of members. We believe everyone deserves access to their own money without predatory fees. You'll work on meaningful data challenges that connect directly to our products and members, with the opportunity to grow your craft and help shape the systems behind a growing financial platform.

About Coursera + Udemy
Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world's most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.
Why join us now?
AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.
Shape what comes next
By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills-and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.
Job Overview:
Analytics Engineering plays a crucial role in building robust and reliable data pipelines and data models that enable data-driven decision-making, powering various analytics, AI, and machine learning initiatives within Coursera. In addition, Analytics Engineering today owns many external facing data products that drive revenue and boost partner and learner satisfaction.
As a Staff Analytics Engineer, you will be architecting high quality and scalable data pipelines powering business critical applications, leading enterprise wide data modeling strategies and driving a culture of transparent, well-governed data systems. You will collaborate with both technical and cross-functional leaders to lead and set direction on how we craft and look at data, while driving industry accepted standards on data governance, discoverability, and accessibility. You will craft technical decisions and design trade-offs to ensure we can speedily deliver on ambitious, innovative goals while building the foundations for extension and scale in years to come.
Responsibilities:
Architect scalable data models and construct high quality ELT pipelines that act as the backbone of our core data lake, with cutting edge technologies such as Airflow, DBT, Databricks, and Sigma. Your work innovates with principles adopted by others.
Design, build, and launch self-serve analytics products from data consumption to data discovery and enablement. Your creations reach far beyond basic dashboarding and are intimately tied with business outcomes, identifying root causes of trends that have immediate impact.
Be a technical leader for the team. Your proficiency in technical and architectural designs for major team initiatives will inspire others. Help shape the future of Analytics Engineering at Coursera and foster a culture of continuous learning and growth.
Be a data leader for the business. Your initiatives will directly increase data literacy, significantly reduce pain points, and resolve data gaps. 
Partner with data scientists, business stakeholders, and product engineers to define, curate, and govern high-fidelity data. Your ability to see KPI interrelationships and how they maximize ROI across the business makes you a recognized bridge connecting data and business outcomes. 
Develop new tools and frameworks in collaboration with other engineers. Your innovative solutions will enable our customers to understand and access data more efficiently, while enhancing frameworks with AI-driven capabilities. 
Basic Qualifications:
10+ years experience in data/analytics engineering with expertise in data architecture, pipelines, and reportingExpert experience with relational databases, DRY data modeling practices, and efficient SQL code generation
Expert experience with some of: AWS, Databricks, Delta Lake, Airflow, dbt, Redshift, Datahub; Databricks preferred, dbt required 
Expert experience with crafting and driving self service reporting solutions with hands on experience in BI Tools; Looker or Sigma preferred 
Strong understanding and demonstrated experience in root cause analysis, with a background in Data Science or Business a plus
Strong experience implementing Data Observability frameworks (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations) at an enterprise level
Strong hands on experience with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, Cursor and its role in streamlining data processing and enabling data democratization
Strong experience with data lake architecture and batch and streaming architectures 
Strong experience in driving industry standards in data governance and technical best practices and driving standards across multiple engineering pods or business disciplines
Strong ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to leadership 
Proven relationships with business end users with clear understanding of how data is used to power business decisions with demonstrated storytelling skills connecting data with trends observed in business
Independence and passion for innovation and learning new technologies; seeks out and creates high-impact projects
Preferred Qualifications:
Strong Experience leading cross-functional RFCs (Request for Comments) and driving technical standards across multiple engineering pods or business disciplines
Strong experience with data lake architecture and batch and streaming architectures 
Proven track record building feature stores or data pipelines specifically for LLM fine-tuning and RAG architectures
Strong track record of leadership and mentorship in elevating data culture, preferably in a remote environment

Job description
The Data Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining the enterprise data infrastructure that powers clinical, operational, and strategic decision-making across Mountain Park Health Center. This position develops reliable data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes, and Dataverse solutions that transform data from multiple sources into accurate, accessible, and actionable information.
 The Data Engineer will collaborate with other IT team members and stakeholders to review, modernize, implement, and maintain data architecture, artificial intelligence, and machine learning based innovations in a healthcare setting to strengthen interoperability in a community focused healthcare organization.
Essential Functions
 
Designs, builds, implements, and maintains scalable data pipelines and Extract Transform Load (ETL)/Extract Load Transform (ELT) processes that integrate data from diverse internal and external systems to support enterprise-wide analytics.
 
Builds and optimizes data pipelines that prepare, transform, and deliver high-quality datasets to support predictive modeling use cases such as patient no-show risk, care gaps, and population health insights.
 
Develops data workflows that support both real-time and scheduled prediction use cases, ensuring the timely delivery of predictive insights for operational decision-making (e.g., scheduling or outreach).
 
Creates and establishes data quality standards, validation frameworks, and monitoring processes while advancing data governance practices, including data definitions and metadata management.
 
Enables interoperability and healthcare data exchange by developing and managing integrations using healthcare standards such as: Health Level Seven (HL7), Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), and modern data exchange methods: Application Programming Interface (APIs), Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP), flat files to ensure seamless and accurate data flow across systems.
 
Partners with clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to identify predictive analytics use cases (e.g., no-show prediction, risk stratification, utilization forecasting) and ensures the necessary data architecture is in place to drive improved patient outcomes and organizational performance.
 
Monitors, troubleshoots, and enhances data pipelines, queries, and storage environments to ensure high performance, reliability, and scalability.
 
Collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure internal customers can confidently and effectively use and trust the data.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Sr. Data Engineer with strong data platform experience to help evolve our modern data stack and contribute to the foundation of our emerging AI and ML platform. The ideal candidate is both a systems thinker and a hands-on builder who thrives in evolving environments and is passionate about creating reliable data infrastructure that enables peers and partner teams to move faster with data. Description
Optum Insight is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us to start 
Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 
 
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cloud Data Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for migrating on-premises database and ETL solutions to a modern cloud-based data platform utilizing Azure Cloud technologies, Snowflake, Python, and Generative AI solutions. This role will also be responsible for leveraging AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and advanced analytics capabilities to automate processes, enhance data accessibility, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate business insights.
 
You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.
 
Primary Responsibilities: 
Lead the migration of ETL workloads from on-premises data warehouse platforms to Azure Cloud and Snowflake
Design, develop, and implement scalable data platform solutions using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Databricks, Self-hosted Integration Runtime (SHIR), Logic Apps, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2), Blob Storage, Snowflake, and Python
Review, analyze, modernize, and optimize existing SSIS, T-SQL, and legacy ETL solutions
 
You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications: 
6+ years of ETL development experience using on-premises databases and ETL technologies
4+ years of experience as a Cloud Data Engineer
3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure Cloud data services including ADF, SHIR, Logic Apps, ADLS Gen2, and Blob Storage
3+ years of experience working with Snowflake data platforms
2+ years of experience working with Databricks
2+ years of experience Python for data engineering, automation, API integration, and AI application development
2+ years of experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar platforms
1+ years of experience with Agile methodologies
Experience developing AI-powered solutions including prompt engineering, document intelligence, semantic search, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
Proven excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
Proven solid communication and collaboration skills
Proven solid analytical skills and attention to detail
Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly
Ability to travel up to 10%
 
Preferred Qualifications: 
Azure Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, and/or Snowflake certifications
Experience designing enterprise AI solutions in Azure cloud environments.
Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Studio, and Azure Machine Learning.
Proven knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and GenAI application architectures.
Experience implementing data governance, data quality, and AI governance frameworks.
Demonstrated familiarity with Spark, MLflow, or machine learning operationalization (MLOps)
Experience with healthcare data platforms, HIPAA compliance, and protected health information (PHI) handling.
Demonstrated familiarity with AWS and Google Cloud Platform data and AI services.
 
*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy
 
Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Description
At 
In Tandem
, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life's biggest transitions. Through our four brands-OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator-we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.  

We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.  

If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.   
As an 
Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling)
, you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling. 

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue. 
What you'll accomplish:

Governed metrics. 
Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly. 

Reporting Finance can run without you.
 Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule. 

Numbers that reconcile. 
Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment. 

Forecasting for Finance. 
Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores. 

Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks. 

Who you are:

Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise. 

Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream. 

An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability. 

AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that. 

Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it. 

Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives. 

What you bring:

3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics. 

Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity. 

Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth. 

Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue. 

Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them. 

Python and Git as daily habits. 

Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:

dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse. 

Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record. 

Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

We're redefining family technology.
  
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.  

Scale meets startup energy.
  
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we're entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.

The Opportunity
This position is a senior engineering role at a data and AI company - which means you'll be close to the product, close to customers, and building systems that are used from day one.
You'll design and ship the data infrastructure at the core of what we sell: modern data platforms, scalable pipelines, and the reporting layers our clients run their businesses on. This role is client facing - you'll be in the room with stakeholders, translating business problems into architecture, and owning the results.
You'll work directly with the CEO and alongside a small, senior team. The problems are real, the feedback loop is short, and the surface area is large. Expect to move fast and own a lot. This is a fully remote position, with the expectation that you'll work primarily Eastern Time hours to stay closely aligned with our team and clients.
What You'll Build
Modern data platforms
 You'll architect and implement data platforms end-to-end. You have deep familiarity with modern data architecture - lakehouse vs. warehouse tradeoffs, ELT patterns, semantic layers, orchestration - and you've implemented Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks in production. You know when to use what, and why.
Scalable, secure pipelines
 You'll build ingestion and transformation pipelines that hold up under real conditions. You have hands-on knowledge of how to build pipelines that scale with data volume and stay secure - access controls, data governance, encryption, and auditability are part of your design, not an afterthought.
Data models that last
 You're opinionated about data modeling. You've worked with star schema, Data Vault, OBT, etc. and you can argue for the right approach given the business context. You design models for business, analytics and AI consumption.
Streaming and real-time systems
 You've implemented streaming pipelines in production, and are familiar with popular technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Redpanda, or similar. You understand the operational realities of streaming: schema evolution, backpressure, exactly-once semantics, and when batch is actually the right answer.
Client-facing delivery
 You'll work directly with client teams - scoping requirements, presenting architecture decisions, and walking stakeholders through tradeoffs. You communicate clearly with both engineers and business leaders, and you're oriented toward results, not just technically elegant solutions.
What You Bring
Significant experience building production data systems, with senior-level ownership of architecture decisions.
Deep understanding of modern data architecture and platforms - you've implemented Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks, not just used them.
Hands-on knowledge of building scalable and secure data pipelines: orchestration, transformation frameworks (dbt or similar), cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).
Strong opinions on data modeling best practices - Kimball, star schema, Data Vault - and the judgment to pick the right one for the problem.
Experience implementing streaming pipelines with Kafka, Flink, Redpanda, or similar.
Clear communication. This role is client facing - you'll present to business stakeholders, explain tradeoffs in plain language, and build trust through delivery.
A business orientation and focus on results: you understand that the pipeline exists to answer a business question, and you make tradeoffs accordingly.
A bias for doing: you'll write the query, sketch the schema, or spin up the prototype if that's what moves things forward.
Why This Role
You'll be a senior engineer at a venture-backed company working on one of the most consequential problems in business right now: making company data actually usable.
Most engineers spend years building inside someone else's platform. Here, you'll help define what the platform is - and your scope and impact will grow as the company does.

Job description
Build the modern data backbone a global travel-rewards business runs on, work hands-on with the newest Microsoft Fabric and AI tooling, and coach the engineers coming up behind you.
About the Role
arrivia
 is looking for an experienced Fabric Data Engineer to take ownership of complex data pipeline architectures inside the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem. You will design and optimize enterprise-scale data solutions, set the technical standards the team works to, and mentor junior engineers along the way.
This work matters right now. You will help migrate an existing on-premise relational database into our modern cloud environment and play an instrumental role in decommissioning legacy data-warehouse systems. The pace is accelerating, and your pipelines are what let the business rely on accurate, up-to-date reports and dashboards.
Your impact reaches across the company. You will partner with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to turn complex requirements into reliable, performant, well-governed data platforms, and the standards you set will shape how the whole team builds.
It is also a genuinely modern role. At 
arrivia
, we are committed to AI-driven innovation, and you will work alongside the latest AI technologies, using LLMs, Model Context Protocol servers, and AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and raise engineering quality. You will also get flexible and hybrid work, certification support, and a clear path to grow into Senior, Lead, and Principal roles.
What You'll Own
Pipeline architecture:
 Architect and optimize end-to-end pipelines with Microsoft Fabric Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, and PySpark and Spark SQL notebooks, built for scale and performance.
Lakehouse and warehouse design:
 Lead Lakehouse and Warehouse design on the medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) pattern, and set the best practices the team follows.
Cloud modernization:
 Help move on-premise relational data into OneLake and retire legacy data-warehouse systems, accelerating the shift to a modern cloud platform.
Real-time ingestion:
 Build low-latency streaming pipelines with Fabric Eventstream from sources such as Azure Event Hubs, IoT Hub, and custom applications.
Performance and reliability:
 Write highly optimized T-SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark, and own incremental loads, refresh scheduling, and SLA monitoring so pipelines stay dependable.
AI-augmented engineering:

Amerit Fleet Solutions is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to establish and maintain a robust data lake infrastructure for enterprise analytics, reporting, and AI/ML initiatives. The role focuses on data architecture, integration, quality, governance, security, performance, documentation, and collaboration across IT, analytics, operations, and AI teams.
Responsibilities
**Data Lake Architecture & Design:** Design and implement a scalable, cloud-based data lake architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP) that ingests, stores, and manages petabyte-scale data from fleet management systems, maintenance records, vendor systems, and operational databases. Establish data zones (raw, curated, analytics) with appropriate access controls and retention policies
**Data Integration & ETL/ELT Pipelines:** Build and maintain automated data pipelines that extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources (work order systems, telematics platforms, financial systems, CRM) into the data lake. Ensure real-time and batch processing capabilities with minimal latency. Document all transformations and business logic
**Data Quality & Integrity Management:** Establish and implement comprehensive data quality frameworks including validation rules, anomaly detection, and reconciliation processes. Monitor data accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Create data quality dashboards and alerts to identify and remediate data issues before they impact downstream analytics. Maintain detailed audit trails for all data changes
**Data Governance & Compliance:** Develop and enforce data governance policies including data cataloging, metadata management, lineage tracking, and PII/sensitive data protection. Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.). Establish data access controls, role-based permissions, and audit logging. Maintain data dictionary and documentation standards
**Performance Optimization & Monitoring:** Monitor data lake performance, query execution times, and storage utilization. Optimize data structures, indexing, and partitioning strategies to ensure sub-second query response times. Implement automated scaling policies and cost optimization initiatives. Provide recommendations for infrastructure improvements
**Data Security & Disaster Recovery:** Implement encryption, secure data access protocols, and disaster recovery/business continuity plans. Establish backup, replication, and recovery procedures with defined RPO/RTO targets. Conduct security audits and vulnerability assessments. Maintain compliance documentation for SOC 2 and other security standards
**Documentation & Knowledge Transfer:** Create comprehensive technical documentation for data lake architecture, data flows, transformation logic, and operational procedures. Develop runbooks for common operations and troubleshooting. Provide training to analysts, data scientists, and other teams on data access, usage best practices, and available datasets
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with business units to understand data requirements and use cases. Collaborate with AI/ML teams on model training data pipelines. Work with analytics teams to optimize queries and reporting. Support data strategy discussions and roadmap planning
